data.name: Meow Below
data.detailed_description:
Your owner lost everything to a pachinko obsession and finally pledged his soul to a demon. The demon granted him one last chance, but refused to let him operate the machine. Now only a cat can save him.

Launch Every Ball Yourself

At the start of each round, the contract machine rolls an integer multiplier and lights several winning slots among the twelve slots at the bottom of the board. Commit your wager, pull the mechanical launcher, and control the strength of the shot. The main ball travels through one continuous track, enters the pin field, and bounces toward its final slot under real-time physics.

There is no direct aiming at a winning slot and no hidden force steering the ball toward a preferred result. Every collision, rebound, and landing is determined by the visible machine and its current physical state.

See the Risk Before You Commit

The multiplier and winning slots are revealed before launch. You may invest additional wager marbles to raise your wager tier, effective wager value, and potential payout, but every marble placed into the machine is permanent.

Preserve your resources with cautious wagers, or take a greater risk when a rare multiplier appears and pursue a payout large enough to clear the contract target.

Turn Every Collision Into Value

Each collision with a pin generates score. When the same ball strikes the same pin repeatedly, its value rises from +1 to +2, +3, and beyond. Even a ball that misses every winning slot can still earn a small amount from the collisions it creates on the way down.

Landing in a winning slot grants a much larger payout based on the round multiplier, committed wager, and current wager tier. A win also returns wager resources and dispenses score cards used to build new abilities.

Trade Score Cards With the Demon

After a win, the machine dispenses physical score cards. Turn away from the machine and hand them to the demon waiting behind you. The demon reveals three upgrade cards. Choose one for the current run; the other two are taken back or burned.

Upgrade cards can change the following rules:

  • Multiplier probabilities and guaranteed minimum results
  • The number and selection rules of winning slots
  • Wager tiers and effective wager multipliers
  • Score generated by collisions in the pin field
  • The creation and payout rules of temporary clone balls
  • Insurance and resource recovery after a missed launch
  • Score card income and the cost of demon trades
  • Temporary machine modifications that last for a limited number of rounds

Build around massive high-multiplier wagers, collision-scoring clones, score card economy, defensive insurance, winning-slot rules, or temporary changes to the board.

Change the Rules, Not the Result

Upgrades can modify probability, rewards, and visible physical properties, but they cannot directly place a ball into a winning slot. Some effects create temporary clones, adjust ball mass or bounce, or remove ordinary pins for several rounds to form new physical paths through the machine.

The strongest effects may demand larger wagers, reduce your margin for error, or make later contract targets more severe. As your build grows stronger, the demon's terms may become more dangerous.

Save Your Owner Before the Contract Expires

Each contract tier has an escalating money target and a limited number of rounds. When those rounds are exhausted, the demon checks your current funds. Meet the target to carry your surplus into the next contract tier. Fall short and the demon takes your owner's soul.

Reach the final target, burn the contract, and save your owner. Otherwise, watch the machine's lights go dark.

Content Notice

This game does not contain real-money gambling, cash redemption, real-world prize redemption, paid random-item purchases, or advertising. All money, wager marbles, balls, score cards, and rewards are fictional in-game resources and cannot be exchanged for real-world currency, goods, or services.

data.short_description: Meow Below is a physics-driven pachinko roguelite about a cat fighting to save its owner's soul. Reveal multipliers and winning slots, decide how much to risk, control every launch, earn score cards, trade with the demon for upgrades, and meet escalating contract targets before time runs out.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit, version 21H1 or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti 2 GB or AMD Radeon R7 360 2 GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
  • VR Support: Virtual reality devices are not supported
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system. An SSD is recommended. The minimum specification targets gameplay at 1920×1080 resolution using the Low graphics preset.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit or Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 3 GB or AMD Radeon RX 570 4 GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 25 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
  • VR Support: Virtual reality devices are not supported
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system. An SSD is recommended. The recommended specification targets 60 FPS at 1920×1080 resolution using the High graphics preset.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains mature themes involving gambling addiction, debt, demonic contracts, imprisonment, and the loss of a soul. The story follows a cat attempting to save its owner, who lost his possessions through compulsive gambling and pledged his soul to a demon.

The gameplay includes simulated gambling-like mechanics using entirely fictional resources, including wager balls, random multipliers, winning slots, and probability-based rewards. The game does not involve real-money gambling, cash prizes, purchasable gambling currency, item trading, or rewards that can be exchanged for real-world money, goods, or services.

The game also contains mild, stylized fantasy violence and potentially frightening imagery. Failure may be depicted through demonic flames, a closing prison door, and the owner’s soul being taken by a demon. These scenes are presented in a non-realistic, cartoon-like dark fantasy style without blood, gore, dismemberment, or graphic physical injury.

The game contains no sexual content, nudity, sexual violence, drug use, self-harm, or suicide.
